title: Admin lifecycle playlet QA harness and idempotency validator
creator: Lena Park
description:
Short summary: Build a lightweight QA harness for 'admin playlets' (runbooks represented as tasks) that can validate idempotency, permission gating, and telemetry signals before a playlet is promoted to the shared catalog. Motivation: we frequently ship admin utilities and micro-runbooks to the ops catalog with intermittent regressions: non-idempotent steps, missing audit events, or RBAC mismatches. This harness aims to catch those automatically in CI and provide deterministic synthetic replays that mirror production step semantics.

Scope: harness framework (CI job + local runner), a set of canonical validations (idempotency, side-effect detection, RBAC simulation), telemetry contract checks (token-level cost, event types, error rates), and a golden-run verifier that compares outputs across model/infra variants. Deliverables: test harness repo + CI integration, a set of 12 canonical playlet testcases, docs for authors, and a dashboard to surface failures.
acceptance_criteria: CI job runs for every PR that modifies playlet schema or runtime plugin and fails on regressions
At least 12 canonical playlet testcases added covering common admin ops patterns
Idempotency validator that can replay a playlet and assert no persistent side-effects (uses sandbox/mock backends)
Telemetry contract validator asserts presence and schema of audit events and token_cost events
Authors can run harness locally via make test-playlet and get deterministic failure traces
Failure dashboard tile created in console-ops showing last 30 failing playlets and flaky score
implementation_notes: Create a new repo redwood/playlet-qa-harness with runner written in Go (reuses existing admin runner libs)
Harness will use a sandbox backend (k8s namespace + ephemeral test doubles) to detect side effects
Idempotency check will snapshot resource state before/after simulated run and compare via canonical serializers
Telemetry validation uses existing event-schema registry; integrate lidar-checker to assert event presence
Add a small shim in the playlet runtime to emit a deterministic run-id for tracing between tests and telemetry
CI job: pipeline stage 'playlet-qa' that runs in parallel with unit tests; configured with permissive timeout (20m)
rollout_plan: MVP: land harness repo and two sample tests (auth-reset, kv-cache-clear) and CI gating on a non-blocking CI stage
Iterate: expand canonical suite to 12 tests and flip CI stage to blocking for playlet-related changes
Monitor: initial 2-week opt-in beta for selected authors; collect telemetry and fix false positives
Enforce: after beta and flake <5%, enable blocking gate and publish author docs and templates
test_plan: Unit tests for the runner and idempotency checker in harness repo
Integration tests that spin up sandbox namespace with mocks for S3/KV and run playlets
Golden-run verification comparing outputs between the current and baseline runtime (automated diff)
Chaos test: disrupt network to validate replay resilience and deterministic failure messaging
Manual author acceptance: 3 runbook authors must pass onboarding checklist and approve docs
